description.value: Located directly on Osoyoos Lake in the South Okanagan, this beachfront resort offers accommodations ranging from basic studio suites to three-bedroom lakefront condos, many with full kitchens and lake-view balconies. The property features a private sandy beach, coin-operated laundry, fitness room, and a social club with pool tables and shuffleboard. It sits within easy reach of several restaurants, wineries, and golf courses that define the Osoyoos region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and confirms address (7506 Main St, Osoyoos, BC V0H 1V0), phone (+1 250 495 7229), and email matching OSM tags. The website consistently brands the property as 'Richter Pass Beach Resort' rather than 'Richter Pass Motel' as recorded in OSM — flagged as a concern. Laundry (coin-operated facilities) and Wi-Fi (free high-speed) are explicitly confirmed by the website; no bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Richter Pass Motel' but the website consistently uses 'Richter Pass Beach Resort' as the operating name throughout all pages. OSM name retained per rules but should be verified and updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating beachfront motel/resort in Osoyoos with a live booking system, confirmed contact details, and substantial website content. A useful stop for touring cyclists in the South Okanagan.

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated laundry facilities listed under amenities on both the front page ('Laundry Service — Coin-operated laundry facilities') and the About Us page ('Guest Laundry Facilities'); some condo units also have in-suite laundry

Nearby evening food.detail: Multiple restaurants listed as nearby: Owl Pub 0.5 miles, Sage Pub 0.3 miles, Campo Marina 0.3 miles, Diamond Streakhouse 0.3 miles, Wildfire Grill 0.3 miles

wow_evidence: beachfront resort... private sandy beach... directly on Osoyoos Lake
